outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Alvaston is a distinct local area enriched by notable landmarks and picturesque outdoor spaces. Among its prominent local sites are Alvaston Park, the Alvaston Nature Trail, and historic Elvaston Castle, which provide scenic surroundings for residents and visitors alike. The community is well served by several public facilities, including the public Alvaston Library and Learning Centre, alongside Boulton Lane Park Community Centre and the Field Lane (Alvaston) Community Association.

Healthcare within the area is delivered through a network of established medical facilities. NHS general practice services in Alvaston are provided from both Alvaston Medical Centre and Coleman Health Centre. In addition, hospital services in the area are based at Lister House at Coleman Street, completing the primary local health infrastructure.

Pharmacy First provides another way for eligible patients to seek help for certain common health conditions. A pharmacist can assess symptoms, consider relevant medicines and medical history, and explain the most appropriate next step. Depending on the clinical assessment, this may include advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby in Derby. Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby is approximately 4.4 km in a straight line from Alvaston.
